newsitem.title: INDIA: India Bank of Baroda launches maiden IPO on Dec 5.
newsitem.headline: India Bank of Baroda launches maiden IPO on Dec 5.

text.p: The Bank of Baroda, one of India's leading state-run banks, will launch its initial public offer (IPO) on December 5, the bank said in a statement on Wednesday.
The 8.5 billion rupees issue consists of 100 million 10-rupee face value equity shares at a premium of 75 per share, it said.
The issue is being made to augment the bank's net worth and to take care of future capital adequacy requirement, the statement said.
The bank, established in 1908, has a domestic network of 2,438 branches besides 38 overseas branches in 10 countries, the statement added.
